_README: Story-arc boundaries for long-running series, keyed by AniList id.
WHY A FILE. Neither AllAnime nor AniList exposes arcs. /episodes returns a flat
list of numbers, so a 131-episode series renders as one undivided grid and there
is no way to find the Beerus saga. This is the only place arc data can come from.
SOURCING RULE. Use the publisher's own division, not a fan subdivision. For
Dragon Ball Super that is Toei Animation's promotional arcs as tabulated by
Wikipedia's List of Dragon Ball Super episodes. An aggregator gave seven finer
arcs with different boundaries (Beerus 1-15, a separate Copy-Vegeta 42-46, a
Paradise Plant 75-76); those are fan-wiki splits. Where sources disagree, prefer
the publisher and record the disagreement here. Checked 2026-10-12.
